items.title: Jimmy Bertrand Interview, 1959-09-09
items.q: The best band I've played was Erskine Tate.

ctx.x: And Father Kelly was my pastor with the Reagan Colts over at 59th and Halstead. You know, not 59th and Halstead. I mean it's 55th and Halstead. And I started taking lessons from Erskine Tate's father. That's old man Jackson at 31st.
